name: MujinaControl-S19
notes: Six-layer nominal 1.6 mm, ENIG, 1 oz outer / 0.5 oz inner. Four fan channels have a 3 A/channel copper target. Q1 is the 3.3 mm NTTFS008P03P8Z with local thermal spreaders for a 14 A input design target; assembled-board thermal and startup qualification remain required. USB, Ethernet and SD routes are present. SD supply and socket grounds are connected; local SD reference planes are filled. Board routing remains incomplete: 102 unconnected items and 75 existing DRC findings. Not for ordering. See docs/q1-upgrade.md, docs/routing-interfaces.md and docs/sd-routing.md. C289/C290 fan bulk capacitors are placed and connected with 1 mm branches and three 0.45/0.30 mm vias per pad. See docs/fan-bulk-capacitors.md. All six buck converters now use TPS62933DRLR with Bonanza passives; the 5 V rail retains a 2 A system budget. Converter transient, thermal and short-circuit qualification remains required. See docs/regulator-reuse.md. All six regulator layouts follow the TPS62933 datasheet topology, with top-side power loops, separate output sensing and stitched ground pours. See docs/regulator-layout.md. Local fan, hashboard-address, supervisor, clock and control routing advanced; see docs/routing-remaining.md. Flash bus, flash supply, boot ADC, codec bias and DDR calibration routing completed; see docs/routing-flash.md.
